questions.question: Choose the correct word: The scientist, ___ theory was later proved correct, was once laughed at.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：那位科学家，其理论后来被证明是正确的，曾经被人嘲笑。
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句，scientist与theory是所属关系（科学家的理论），用whose。whose在非限制性定语从句中表所属，可指人指物。逗号隔开=非限制性，不能用that。whose theory=the theory of the scientist。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：非限制性定语从句whose表所属（逗号隔开不可用that）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 那位科学家，其理论后来被证明是正确的，曾经被人嘲笑。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The meeting ___ over, everyone went home.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：会议结束后，大家都回家了。
questions.explanation: 独立主格结构The meeting being over中meeting是逻辑主语，being over表状态。独立主格=名词+分词（自身有主语）。meeting与be是主动关系→being。The meeting being over=会议结束后（表时间/原因）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格（名词+现在分词being，表状态）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 会议结束后，大家都回家了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: The project ___ (complete) next month is very important.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：下个月将完成的那个项目非常重要。
questions.explanation: 不定式被动式to be completed作后置定语，表将来被动。project与complete是被动关系（项目被完成），且next month表将来→to be done。不定式表将来，被动用to be done。现在分词doing表进行，过去分词done表完成。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：不定式被动式to be done作定语（表将来被动）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 下个月将完成的那个项目非常重要。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: If he had taken the medicine yesterday, he ___ better now.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果他昨天吃了药，现在就会好些了。
questions.explanation: 混合条件句：if从句与过去相反（had taken，yesterday），主句与现在相反（now→would+动词原形）。从句had taken表过去虚拟，主句now表现在虚拟→would feel。错综时间虚拟：从句和主句时间不一致，各自按对应时间虚拟。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：混合条件句（从句过去虚拟+主句现在虚拟）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他昨天吃了药，现在就会好些了。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Were it not ___ your help, I would fail.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：要不是你的帮助，我就会失败。
questions.explanation: 虚拟倒装省略if：Were it not for=If it were not for（要不是）。if虚拟条件句省略if时，were/had/should提到主语前倒装。Were it not for your help=If it were not for your help。for搭配were it not for固定。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装省略：虚拟条件句省if倒装（Were it not for=If it were not for）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是你的帮助，我就会失败。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It ___ that the earth is round.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：据证明地球是圆的。
questions.explanation: 学术写作常用被动It is proved that...（据证明...）。It是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。学术被动结构：It is said/reported/believed/proved that...。被动语态在学术写作中表客观，避免主观。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：It is proved that形式主语+被动（表客观）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据证明地球是圆的。

questions.question: Which interpretation(s) is/are possible for: 'I saw the man with a telescope.'?
questions.questionCn: 以下哪种理解是可能的：'I saw the man with a telescope.'？
choices: A. Only 'I used a telescope to see the man'
B. Only 'The man had a telescope'
C. Both A and B are possible
D. Neither A nor B makes sense
questions.explanation: 结构歧义。with a telescope可修饰saw（我用望远镜看）或the man（拿着望远镜的男人）。介词短语修饰歧义是常见语法歧义。消除歧义需语境或改写：I used a telescope to see the man / I saw the man who had a telescope.
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：介词短语修饰歧义（with a telescope修饰对象不明）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我用望远镜看到了那个男人。/ 我看到了那个拿着望远镜的男人。

questions.question: Choose the correct structure: I would rather stay at home ___ go out in the rain.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确结构：我宁愿待在家里也不冒雨出门。
questions.explanation: would rather...than...=宁愿...而不...，连接两个对等结构。rather than=而不是，表选择。would rather do A than do B。也可单独用rather than连接：He decided to walk rather than drive.
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：would rather...than...（宁愿...而不...）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我宁愿待在家里也不冒雨出门。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: No sooner ___ home than it began to rain.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我刚到家就开始下雨了。
questions.explanation: No sooner...than...否定词开头部分倒装，had提到主语前。No sooner had I reached home than...=我刚到家就下雨。No sooner...than=一...就...，had+过去分词提到主语前=部分倒装。主句用过去完成时。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：No sooner...than...部分倒装（had+主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我刚到家就开始下雨了。

questions.question: Choose the best translation for: 只有这样我们才能解决问题。
questions.questionCn: 选择最佳翻译：只有这样我们才能解决问题。
choices: A. Only in this way we can solve the problem
B. Only in this way can we solve the problem
C. Only in this way we could solve the problem
D. Only in this way could solve the problem
questions.explanation: Only+状语置于句首，主句部分倒装：can we solve。中英句式转换：中文'只有...才'对应Only...can，且Only开头需倒装。Only in this way can we...=只有这样我们才能...。部分倒装：can提到we前。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译转换：中文'只有...才'→Only+倒装句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 只有这样我们才能解决问题。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The book which I borrowed it from the library is interesting.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我从图书馆借的那本书很有趣。
questions.explanation: 错误。which已在从句中作borrowed的宾语（borrowed the book→borrowed which），it是多余宾语。正确：The book which I borrowed from the library is interesting. 定语从句关系代词作宾语时，从句不能再出现该宾语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：关系代词作宾语后从句不能再重复宾语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我从图书馆借的那本书很有趣。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The report having been discussed, the committee made a decision.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：报告讨论完毕后，委员会做出了决定。
questions.explanation: 正确。Having been discussed是独立主格的完成被动式，report与discuss是被动关系（报告被讨论），且讨论发生在决定之前。名词+having been done=独立主格完成被动，表被动且先于主句。结构：The report having been discussed, ...
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格完成被动式（名词+having been done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 报告讨论完毕后，委员会做出了决定。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Without your help, I will fail the exam.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：没有你的帮助，我就会考试不及格。
questions.explanation: 错误。Without表含蓄虚拟（=If there were no），与现在/将来相反用would+动词原形。正确：Without your help, I would fail the exam. 含蓄虚拟词：without/but for/or else，后接would/could/should+动词原形。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：without含蓄虚拟（=if条件句，用would）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 没有你的帮助，我就会考试不及格。

questions.question: Judge true or false: In 'The research conducted by the team was published in a journal.', 'conducted by the team' is a past participle phrase used as a post-modifier.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：在'The research conducted by the team was published in a journal.'中，conducted by the team是过去分词短语作后置定语。
questions.explanation: 正确。conducted by the team是过去分词短语作后置定语修饰the research。research与conduct是被动关系（研究被进行）→过去分词conducted。长定语后置是学术写作特点：名词+过去分词短语，=which was conducted by the team。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：过去分词短语作长后置定语（=which was done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 团队进行的研究发表在了一本期刊上。

questions.question: Judge true or false: 'Flying planes can be dangerous.' has only one meaning.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：'Flying planes can be dangerous.'只有一种意思。
questions.explanation: 错误。此句有两种理解：1)flying planes（飞行中的飞机）can be dangerous（很危险）；2)Flying planes（驾驶飞机）can be dangerous（很危险）。现在分词flying修饰歧义：作定语（飞行的飞机）vs作动名词主语（驾驶飞机）。结构歧义需语境消除。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：现在分词flying修饰歧义（定语vs动名词主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 飞行中的飞机可能很危险。/ 驾驶飞机可能很危险。

questions.question: Judge true or false: 'People say that he is honest.' can be converted to the passive form 'It is said that he is honest.'
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：'People say that he is honest.'可以转换为被动形式'It is said that he is honest.'。
questions.explanation: 正确。主动People say that→被动It is said that...（据说）。People say+that从句→It is said that+从句。主动变被动句型转换：主语People→形式主语It，谓语say→is said。It is said/reported/believed that是常见被动句型。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译转换：People say that→It is said that被动句型转换
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据说他很诚实。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: He left the room, ___ (follow) by his dog.
questions.questionCn: 填空：他离开了房间，身后跟着他的狗。
questions.explanation: 分词作伴随状语，he与follow是被动关系（被跟随），用过去分词followed。followed by his dog=被他的狗跟着。分词作状语看与主句主语关系：主动用doing，被动用done。he是被跟的对象→followed。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：分词作伴随状语，被动用followed by
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他离开了房间，身后跟着他的狗。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ (criticize) by the teacher made the boy cry.
questions.questionCn: 填空：被老师批评让男孩哭了。
questions.explanation: 动名词作主语，the boy与criticize是被动关系，用动名词被动式being done。Being criticized=被批评这件事。动名词作主语表'做某事'，被动用being done。Being criticized made the boy cry=被批评让他哭了。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：动名词被动式being done作主语
questions.sentenceTranslation: 被老师批评让男孩哭了。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: Here ___ (come) the bus!
questions.questionCn: 填空：公交车来了！
questions.explanation: 完全倒装：表地点的副词(here/there)开头+谓语+主语（名词）。Here comes the bus=公交车来了。完全倒装规则：副词(here/there/up/down)+动词+主语（名词），主语是代词则不倒装(Here it comes)。comes与the bus（名词）倒装。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装省略：here/there完全倒装（名词主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 公交车来了！

questions.question: Fill in the blank: It is necessary that every student ___ (hand in) the homework on time.
questions.questionCn: 填空：每个学生必须按时交作业。
questions.explanation: It is necessary/important/essential that+主语从句用虚拟语气：(should)+动词原形。It is necessary that every student (should) hand in...=每个学生必须按时交作业。形容词necessary/important/essential后主语从句用should do（should可省）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：It is necessary that+主语从句虚拟(should do)
questions.sentenceTranslation: 每个学生必须按时交作业。

questions.question: Clarify the two meanings of 'Visiting relatives can be boring' by completing both paraphrases: 1) ___ to visit relatives can be boring. 2) Relatives ___ visit us can be boring.
questions.questionCn: 用释义消除歧义，补全两种理解：'Visiting relatives can be boring'。1)去拜访亲戚很无聊。2)来访的亲戚很无聊。
questions.explanation: 结构歧义。visiting relatives可理解为：1)动名词visiting+宾语relatives（去拜访亲戚）；2)现在分词visiting+名词relatives（来访的亲戚）。消除歧义用不定式/关系从句改写：To visit relatives... / Relatives who visit...
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：visiting relatives同形歧义（动名词vs现在分词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 去拜访亲戚可能很无聊。/ 来访的亲戚可能很无聊。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ hard he tried, he could not solve the problem.
questions.questionCn: 填空：无论他多么努力，都解决不了这个问题。
questions.explanation: However引导让步状语从句：However+adj/adv+主语+谓语。However hard he tried=无论他多么努力。however=无论多么，后接形容词/副词。结构：However+adj/adv+主语+谓语。对比no matter how+adj/adv同义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：However+adj/adv引导让步从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 无论他多么努力，都解决不了这个问题。

questions.question: Combine into one sentence: The day will come. You will regret your words then.
questions.questionCn: 合并为一句：那一天总会到来。到那时你会后悔你说的话。
questions.answer: The day will come when you will regret your words.
questions.explanation: when引导定语从句修饰the day，因从句长为避免头重脚轻后置（分隔定语从句）。when=on that day。结构：主句+when从句（后置）。分隔定语从句：先行词与定语从句被谓语等成分隔开。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：分隔定语从句（先行词与从句分离，避免头重脚轻）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 你后悔自己话语的那一天总会到来。

questions.question: Rewrite using 'but for': If it had not rained, we would have gone camping.
questions.questionCn: 用but for改写：要不是下雨，我们就去露营了。
questions.answer: But for the rain, we would have gone camping.
questions.explanation: but for表含蓄虚拟，=if it had not been for。与过去相反用would have done。but for the rain=要不是下雨。含蓄虚拟结构：but for/without+名词+would have done/would do。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟高阶：but for含蓄虚拟（=if it had not been for）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是下雨，我们就去露营了。

questions.question: Rewrite using 'nor/neither': He can't speak French. I can't speak French either.
questions.questionCn: 用nor/neither改写：他不会说法语。我也不会。
questions.answer: He can't speak French, nor can I.
questions.explanation: 否定句后接nor/neither+be/助/情+主语=也不。前句can't否定，后句nor can I=我也不能。nor/neither开头部分倒装：情态动词can提到I前。结构：nor/neither+情态/助/be+主语。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装省略：nor/neither否定倒装（nor+情态+主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不会说法语，我也不会。

questions.question: Explain the ambiguity in: 'They fed her dog biscuits.' Give two interpretations.
questions.questionCn: 解释歧义：'They fed her dog biscuits.'给出两种理解。
questions.answer: 1) They fed biscuits to her dog. 2) They fed her dog-biscuits.
questions.explanation: 结构歧义。her dog biscuits可理解为：1)her dog是fed的宾语，biscuits是补语（喂她狗吃饼干，即fed biscuits to her dog）；2)dog biscuits是复合名词（狗饼干），her修饰（喂她狗饼干）。双宾语vs复合名词结构歧义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：双宾语vs复合名词结构歧义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他们喂她的狗吃了饼干。/ 他们喂她吃狗饼干。

questions.question: Split into two simple sentences: The boy who is wearing a red coat is my brother.
questions.questionCn: 拆分为两个简单句：穿红色外套的男孩是我弟弟。
questions.answer: The boy is my brother. He is wearing a red coat.
questions.explanation: 长句拆分：定语从句拆为独立句。who is wearing a red coat修饰the boy，拆分后用He指代the boy作独立句主语。长句拆分技巧：找从句→拆为独立句→用代词衔接。合并则用定语从句连接。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译转换：长句拆分（定语从句→独立句+代词衔接）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 穿红色外套的男孩是我弟弟。

questions.passage: It has been widely argued that the findings reported in this study, which were obtained through a rigorous experimental design, challenge the prevailing assumption that intelligence is fixed. The data, having been collected over a period of five years, indicate that cognitive abilities can be significantly enhanced through targeted training. It is therefore recommended that further research be conducted to explore the mechanisms underlying this phenomenon.
questions.passageCn: 人们普遍认为，本研究报告的发现——这些发现是通过严格的实验设计获得的——挑战了智力是固定不变的这一普遍假设。经过五年时间收集的数据表明，认知能力可以通过有针对性的训练得到显著提升。因此，建议开展进一步研究以探索这一现象背后的机制。

subQuestions.question: What function does 'which were obtained through a rigorous experimental design' serve in the passage?
subQuestions.questionCn: 短文中'which were obtained through a rigorous experimental design'起什么作用？
choices: B. 非限制性定语从句（补充说明findings）
subQuestions.explanation: which引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明the findings（先行词指物用which）。逗号隔开表非限制性，which were obtained=被发现/获得。which在从句中作主语。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：非限制性定语从句which（逗号隔开，指物作主语）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 本研究报告的发现是通过严格的实验设计获得的。

subQuestions.question: True or False: In 'It is therefore recommended that further research be conducted', 'be conducted' is in the subjunctive mood (should be omitted).
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：在'It is therefore recommended that further research be conducted'中，'be conducted'用了虚拟语气（省略了should）。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。recommend后的主语从句用虚拟语气：(should)+动词原形。should be conducted省略should后为be conducted。recommend/demand/suggest/insist等动词后的从句用should do（should可省）。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 学术句式：recommend后主语从句虚拟(should do，should可省)
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 因此，建议开展进一步研究。

questions.passage: The old man, who had spent his entire life in the village where he was born, refused to leave even when his children, all of whom had settled in the city, begged him to move. 'This is the place that holds my memories,' he said, 'and no matter what happens, I will never abandon the house that my father built with his own hands.' What his children did not understand was that the house meant more to him than just shelter.
questions.passageCn: 那位老人，他在自己出生的村庄里度过了整整一生，即使他的孩子们——他们全都已在城市安家——恳求他搬走，他也拒绝离开。'这个地方承载着我的回忆，'他说，'无论发生什么，我都永远不会放弃我父亲亲手建造的这栋房子。'他的孩子们不理解的是，这栋房子对他来说远不止是一个住所。

subQuestions.question: How many relative clauses are there in the first sentence of the passage?
subQuestions.questionCn: 短文第一句中有几个定语从句？
subQuestions.explanation: 第一句含三个定语从句：1)who had spent...修饰the old man；2)where he was born修饰the village；3)all of whom had settled in the city修饰his children。多重定语从句嵌套是六级复杂从句的典型特征。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：多重定语从句嵌套（who+where+whom）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 那位在自己出生的村庄里度过了一生的老人，即使孩子们恳求他搬走，他也拒绝离开。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'What his children did not understand was that the house meant more to him than just shelter' contains both a subject clause and a predicative clause.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'What his children did not understand was that...'中同时包含主语从句和表语从句。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。What his children did not understand是主语从句（what作understand的宾语），was后that the house meant more...是表语从句。一个句子中嵌套主语从句+表语从句是复杂从句结构。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：主语从句(what)+表语从句(that)嵌套
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 他的孩子们不理解的是，这栋房子对他来说远不止是一个住所。

questions.passage: No sooner had the new policy been announced than critics began to voice their concerns. Not only did they argue that the measures were impractical, but they also pointed out that the government had failed to consult the public. However hard the officials tried to defend the policy, the opposition remained strong. The controversy was such that the matter was referred to a special committee, whose task was to review the proposal in detail.
questions.passageCn: 新政策一公布，批评者就开始表达他们的担忧。他们不仅认为这些措施不切实际，还指出政府未能征求公众意见。无论官员们多么努力地为政策辩护，反对声依然强烈。争议如此之大，以至于此事被提交给了一个特别委员会，其任务是详细审查该提案。

subQuestions.question: What structure is used in 'No sooner had the new policy been announced than critics began to voice their concerns'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'No sooner had the new policy been announced than...'使用了什么结构？
subQuestions.explanation: No sooner...than...否定词开头部分倒装，had提到主语the new policy前。No sooner had...than...=一...就...。部分倒装：助动词/情态/be提到主语前。had been announced是过去完成时被动。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：No sooner...than...部分倒装+被动语态
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 新政策一公布，批评者就开始表达他们的担忧。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'However hard the officials tried' uses 'However' to introduce an adverbial clause of concession.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'However hard the officials tried'用However引导让步状语从句。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。However+adj/adv+主语+谓语引导让步状语从句。However hard=无论多么努力。However=无论多么，后接副词hard。对比no matter how同义。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：However+adv引导让步从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 无论官员们多么努力地为政策辩护，反对声依然强烈。

subQuestions.question: What does 'such that' mean in 'The controversy was such that the matter was referred to a special committee'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 在'The controversy was such that...'中，'such that'是什么意思？
subQuestions.explanation: such that=如此...以至于。such是代词指代争议的程度，that引导结果状语从句。The controversy was such that...=争议如此之大以至于...。such...that结构与so...that同义但用法不同。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：such that引导结果状语从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 争议如此之大，以至于此事被提交给了一个特别委员会。

questions.question: Choose the correct word: The day will come ___ we can travel to space easily.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确词：我们能轻松地去太空旅行的那一天终将到来。
questions.explanation: 这是分隔定语从句。先行词The day与定语从句被will come分隔。when是关系副词，修饰表时间的先行词The day，在从句中作时间状语。分隔定语从句：先行词与定语从句之间插入了谓语动词或其他成分，造成分隔。= The day when we can travel to space easily will come. when=on which。关系副词when修饰时间名词，where修饰地点名词，why修饰reason。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：分隔定语从句，when修饰先行词The day
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们能轻松地去太空旅行的那一天终将到来。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: Weather ___, we will go camping tomorrow.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：天气允许的话，我们明天去露营。
questions.explanation: 这是独立主格结构。Weather与permit是主动关系（天气允许），用现在分词permitting。独立主格：名词/代词+分词/形容词/副词/不定式，逻辑主语与主句主语不同。Weather permitting=天气允许的话（Weather是permitting的逻辑主语，与主句主语we不同）。独立主格表条件、原因、伴随等。= If weather permits, we will go camping tomorrow. 俄语中有类似结构，但英语独立主格用分词形式。
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：独立主格Weather permitting（名词+现在分词）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 天气允许的话，我们明天去露营。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: If he had followed my advice then, he ___ in trouble now.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果他当时听了我的建议，他现在就不会有麻烦了。
questions.explanation: 这是错综时间虚拟语气（混合条件句）。if从句与过去相反（had followed），但主句有now，与现在相反（would not be）。if从句用过去完成时had followed（过去的过去），主句用would+动词原形be（与现在相反）。错综时间虚拟：从句和主句时间不一致，各自用对应时态。判断关键：if从句时间词then→过去完成时；主句时间词now→would+原形。这是高级虚拟语气难点。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气高阶：错综时间，if从句过去完成时+主句would+原形（现在）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果他当时听了我的建议，他现在就不会有麻烦了。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ it rain tomorrow, we would have to cancel the trip.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：如果明天下雨，我们就不得不取消旅行。
questions.explanation: 这是虚拟条件句的倒装省略形式。在虚拟条件句中，如果省略if，需将were/should/had提到主语前。Should it rain=If it should rain（如果万一明天下雨）。与将来相反的虚拟：if从句用should+原形/过去式/were to+原形。省略if倒装：Should it rain（should提前），Were it to rain（were提前），Had it rained（had提前，表过去）。should提前表'万一'，语气较弱。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：虚拟条件句省略if→Should+主语+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果明天下雨，我们就不得不取消旅行。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: It ___ that regular exercise can significantly improve mental health.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：据证实，规律的运动能显著改善心理健康。
questions.explanation: 学术写作中常用It is/was+过去分词+that从句的被动结构。此处表已证实的研究结论，用现在完成时被动has been shown。It是形式主语，that从句是真正主语。学术被动结构：It is widely acknowledged that...（人们普遍认为），It has been shown that...（已证实），It is reported that...（据报道）。学术英语倾向用被动语态使表达更客观。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术写作：It has been shown that...（形式主语+被动+真正主语）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据证实，规律的运动能显著改善心理健康。

questions.question: Choose the sentence with NO ambiguity:
questions.questionCn: 选择没有歧义的句子：
choices: A. I saw the man with the telescope.
B. I saw the man using the telescope.
C. I used the telescope to see the man.
D. I saw the man who had a telescope.
questions.explanation: A有歧义：with the telescope可修饰saw（用望远镜看）或the man（带望远镜的男人）。B有歧义：using可修饰saw或the man。D有歧义：who had a telescope修饰the man，但'有望远镜'的人是否在看不明。C无歧义：I used the telescope to see the man.（我用望远镜看那个男人。）句意明确，主语I执行used和saw。语法歧义常因修饰语位置或介词短语归属不明造成。学术写作应避免歧义。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：介词短语with the telescope修饰歧义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我用望远镜看那个男人。

questions.question: Choose the correct form: ___ had we arrived at the airport than the flight was cancelled.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我们刚到机场，航班就取消了。
questions.explanation: No sooner...than...=一...就...，固定结构。No sooner置于句首时主句部分倒装。No sooner had we arrived=我们刚到。搭配：No sooner...than...（一...就...），Hardly/Scarcely...when...（刚...就...）。注意搭配不可混淆：No sooner配than，Hardly/Scarcely配when。No sooner+had+主语+过去分词+than+从句。= We had no sooner arrived than the flight was cancelled.
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：No sooner...than...（一...就...）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我们刚到机场，航班就取消了。

questions.question: Choose the best transformation of: 'People say that he is a genius.' (Passive)
questions.questionCn: 选择最佳转换：'人们说他是个天才。'（被动语态）
choices: A. He is said to be a genius.
B. He is said that he is a genius.
C. It is said he to be a genius.
D. A genius is said he is.
questions.explanation: People say that he is a genius.转换为被动：It is said that he is a genius. 或 He is said to be a genius. 后者更简洁：主语he+is said+to be（不定式）。不定式时态：to be（同时/现在），to have been（过去）。= It is said that he is a genius. = He is said to be a genius. 被动转换使主语变为原从句主语he，用不定式to be替代that从句。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译与转换：He is said to be...（被动+不定式替代that从句）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 据说他是个天才。

questions.question: Judge true or false: The book that I borrowed it from the library is very interesting.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：我从图书馆借的那本书很有趣。
questions.explanation: 错误。that在定语从句中作borrowed的宾语，不能再加it，造成宾语重复。正确：The book that I borrowed from the library is very interesting. 关系代词that/which/who在从句中作宾语时，that本身即宾语，不需再加代词。= The book which I borrowed... 或 The book I borrowed...（作宾语可省略）。俄语关系代词用法不同，英语定语从句中关系代词已充当成分，不重复。
questions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：关系代词that作宾语时不可再加it
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我从图书馆借的那本书很有趣。

questions.question: Judge true or false: With all the work finished, we can go home now.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：所有工作都完成了，我们现在可以回家了。
questions.explanation: 正确。With+宾语+过去分词构成with复合结构。all the work与finish是被动关系（工作被完成），用过去分词finished。With all the work finished=所有工作完成后（表原因/条件）。with复合结构：With+宾语+宾补（分词/形容词/副词/不定式/介词短语）。主动用doing，被动用done。= Because all the work has been finished, we can go home.
questions.knowledgePoint: 非谓语高级：with复合结构，With+宾语+过去分词finished
questions.sentenceTranslation: 所有工作都完成了，我们现在可以回家了。

questions.question: Judge true or false: But for your help, I will not succeed.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：要不是你的帮助，我是不会成功的。
questions.explanation: 错误。But for=要不是，引导含蓄虚拟语气，需用虚拟语气。与现在事实相反用would+原形，与过去相反用would have+过去分词。句意'要不是你的帮助，我不会成功'与现在/过去相反。正确：But for your help, I would not succeed.（与现在相反）或 But for your help, I would not have succeeded.（与过去相反）。含蓄虚拟：but for, without, but that等隐含条件，需用虚拟语气。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气高阶：But for+虚拟语气（would+原形/have done）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 要不是你的帮助，我是不会成功的。

questions.question: Judge true or false: Try as he might, he could not solve the problem.
questions.questionCn: 判断对错：尽管他尽力了，他还是无法解决这个问题。
questions.explanation: 正确。as引导让步状语从句时用倒装：动词原形/形容词/副词/名词+as+主语+谓语。Try as he might=尽管他尽力。as让步倒装结构：①动词原形+as+主语+助动词（Try as he might）；②形容词+as+主语+be（Young as he is）；③名词+as+主语+谓语（Child as he is）。as=though/although，但语序特殊。俄语让步从句语序不同，英语as让步倒装是固定结构。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与省略：as让步倒装，动词原形+as+主语+助动词
questions.sentenceTranslation: 尽管他尽力了，他还是无法解决这个问题。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: A survey ___ (conduct) among college students reveals interesting findings.
questions.questionCn: 填空：一项在大学生中进行的调查揭示了有趣的发现。
questions.explanation: conducted是过去分词作后置定语修饰survey。survey与conduct是被动关系（调查被进行），用过去分词conducted。= A survey which was conducted among college students... 学术写作中常用过去分词作后置定语使句子简洁。名词化：将动词conduct转为过去分词conducted作定语。学术写作特点：多用被动、名词化、分词定语，使表达更正式客观。
questions.knowledgePoint: 学术写作：过去分词conducted作后置定语表被动（名词化）
questions.sentenceTranslation: 一项在大学生中进行的调查揭示了有趣的发现。

questions.question: Fill in the blank to remove ambiguity: I gave the book to ___ (make clear: not him, but her).
questions.questionCn: 填空以消除歧义：我把书给了___（明确：不是给他，而是给她）。
questions.explanation: 歧义句I gave the book to him/her中，若主语和宾语代词模糊，会造成理解困难。用明确代词her消除歧义。语法歧义类型：①修饰歧义（with the telescope修饰谁）；②指代歧义（he指谁）；③结构歧义（old men and women的分组）。消除歧义方法：①调整语序；②使用明确代词；③添加逗号或重写。学术写作应避免代词指代不明。
questions.knowledgePoint: 语法歧义：代词指代明确化消除歧义
questions.sentenceTranslation: 我把书给了她。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: However difficult the task is, we will try ___ best to complete it.
questions.questionCn: 填空：无论任务多困难，我们都会尽全力完成它。
questions.explanation: try one's best=尽某人全力，固定搭配。主语是we，用our best。try one's best中one's随主语变化：I→my, you→your, he→his, she→her, we→our, they→their。However引导让步状语从句：However+形容词/副词+主语+谓语=无论多么...。However difficult the task is=无论任务多难。= No matter how difficult the task is。
questions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：try one's best + However引导让步从句
questions.sentenceTranslation: 无论任务多困难，我们都会尽全力完成它。

questions.question: Fill in the blank: ___ (not only...but also转换) does he speak English, but he also writes it well.
questions.questionCn: 填空：他不仅会说英语，而且写得也很好。（not only...but also倒装转换）
questions.explanation: Not only置于句首时，前半句部分倒装。原句：He not only speaks English but also writes it well. 转换：Not only does he speak English, but he also writes it well. 倒装：Not only+助动词does+主语he+动词原形speak。but also后不倒装。句型转换技巧：把not only从句中提到句首→倒装。强调'不仅...而且'中的前半部分。
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译与转换：not only句首→部分倒装does he speak
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他不仅会说英语，而且写得也很好。

questions.question: Rewrite using mixed conditional: 如果我当时努力学习，我现在就通过考试了。（if从句与过去相反，主句与现在相反）
questions.questionCn: 用混合条件句改写：如果我当时努力学习，我现在就通过考试了。
questions.answer: If I had studied hard then, I would pass the exam now.
questions.explanation: 错综时间混合条件句：if从句与过去相反（had studied），主句与现在相反（would pass）。if从句用过去完成时had+过去分词（表过去未发生），主句用would+动词原形（表现在的结果）。判断关键：if从句时间词then→过去完成时；主句时间词now→would+原形。混合条件句是虚拟语气高级用法，从句和主句时间不同，各自用对应形式。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气高阶：混合条件句，if从句过去完成时+主句would+原形
questions.sentenceTranslation: 如果我当时努力学习，我现在就通过考试了。

questions.question: Transform into a passive sentence: 大家认为他是这个项目最合适的人选。
questions.questionCn: 转换为被动句：大家认为他是这个项目最合适的人选。
questions.answer: He is considered to be the most suitable person for the project.
questions.explanation: 主动句'大家认为他是...'转换为被动句：He is considered to be...。结构：主语(he)+被动谓语(is considered)+不定式(to be)+表语。consider sb to be sth（认为某人是...）→sb is considered to be sth。不定式时态：to be（同时/现在），to have been（过去）。被动+不定式替代that从句，使表达更简洁正式。= It is considered that he is the most suitable person...
questions.knowledgePoint: 翻译与转换：被动转换He is considered to be...
questions.sentenceTranslation: 他被认为是这个项目最合适的人选。

questions.passage: It was a cold winter morning when the children decided to build a snowman. The snow, which had fallen heavily during the night, was perfect for rolling. What excited them most was the idea of decorating it with colorful scarves. The snowman they built was so tall that it could be seen from across the street. Not until the sun came out did they realize how cold their hands had become. Nevertheless, the joy they experienced was something they would never forget.
questions.passageCn: 那是一个寒冷的冬日早晨，孩子们决定堆一个雪人。夜里下的大雪非常适合滚雪球。最让他们兴奋的是用彩色围巾装饰雪人的想法。他们堆的雪人很高，从街对面都能看到。直到太阳出来，他们才意识到自己的手已经变得多冷。然而，他们体验到的快乐是他们永远不会忘记的。

subQuestions.question: What type of clause is 'when the children decided to build a snowman'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'when the children decided to build a snowman'是什么类型的从句？
subQuestions.explanation: when引导时间状语从句，修饰主句It was a cold winter morning，说明事情发生的时间。when=当...的时候。注意：when也可引导定语从句（修饰时间名词，如the day when...），但此处morning前有a，且when从句修饰整个主句而非morning，故为状语从句。区分关键：when从句是否紧跟在时间名词后且修饰该名词。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 复杂从句：when引导时间状语从句
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 那是一个寒冷的冬日早晨，孩子们决定堆一个雪人。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Not until the sun came out did they realize' uses inversion correctly.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Not until the sun came out did they realize'正确使用了倒装。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。Not until置于句首时，主句部分倒装。Not until+时间状语从句+did+主语+动词原形。Not until the sun came out did they realize=直到太阳出来他们才意识到。部分倒装：did they realize（did提前）。= They did not realize until the sun came out. Not until倒装强调时间。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 倒装与从句：Not until句首→主句部分倒装did they realize
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 直到太阳出来，他们才意识到自己的手已经变得多冷。

questions.passage: Last summer, our family went on a trip to Yunnan. No sooner had we arrived than we were captivated by the beautiful scenery. The more we traveled, the more we wanted to explore. Try as we might to follow the schedule, we kept getting lost in the charming old towns. It was not until the third day that we found our way around. However tired we were, the trip was worth every moment. We would rather have stayed longer, but time was limited.
questions.passageCn: 去年夏天，我们全家去云南旅行。我们刚到就被美丽的风景迷住了。我们越旅行，就越想探索更多。尽管我们努力按照行程走，还是不断在迷人的古镇里迷路。直到第三天我们才找到路。无论多累，这趟旅行每一刻都值得。我们宁愿多待一段时间，但时间有限。

subQuestions.question: Which structure is used in 'The more we traveled, the more we wanted to explore'?
subQuestions.questionCn: 'The more we traveled, the more we wanted to explore'使用了什么结构？
subQuestions.explanation: The+比较级..., the+比较级...=越...越...。The more we traveled, the more we wanted to explore=我们越旅行，越想探索。此结构前后两个the+比较级对应，表两个事物同向变化。比较级可换形容词：The harder you work, the better you will be.（越努力越好。）固定结构，两半句都用the+比较级开头。
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：The+比较级..., the+比较级...（越...越...）
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 我们越旅行，就越想探索更多。

subQuestions.question: True or False: 'Try as we might' is an inversion structure meaning 'although we tried'.
subQuestions.questionCn: 判断：'Try as we might'是倒装结构，意为'尽管我们努力了'。
subQuestions.explanation: 正确。as引导让步状语从句时用倒装：动词原形+as+主语+助动词。Try as we might=尽管我们尽力。as=although/though，但语序特殊。as让步倒装变体：①动词原形+as+主语+助动词（Try as we might）；②形容词+as+主语+be（Tired as we were）；③名词+as+主语+谓语。= Although we tried hard, we kept getting lost.
subQuestions.knowledgePoint: 高级固定结构：as让步倒装Try as we might=although
subQuestions.sentenceTranslation: 尽管我们努力按照行程走，还是不断迷路。
